trainsOnDataNuance: Free, Plus, and Pro accounts train on your data by default. API, Team, and Enterprise accounts are excluded from training.
optOutHow: Change your training preference in account Data Controls; the policy links to a help-center article on opting out and does not name a specific toggle.
retentionPeriod: Retained only as long as needed to provide the service; deleted data is removed within 30 days; Temporary Chats are deleted within 30 days; longer retention applies for security, safety, and legal obligations.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You can delete individual chats or your entire account. Deletion takes up to 30 days. Backup copies may remain for a short time after.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with vendors, service providers, and affiliates for operations, security monitoring, and legal compliance. Not sold to advertisers.
humanReviewConditions: A sample of chats may be reviewed by human trainers to improve safety and performance. This does not apply if you have opted out of training or use enterprise/API services.
regionalVariation: EEA, UK, and Swiss users follow a separate privacy policy with full GDPR rights, including the right to object and request deletion through dedicated regional compliance workflows.
childrenDataPolicy: Minimum age is 13 (or regional equivalent). Users under 18 need parental or guardian consent. OpenAI does not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Business offerings such as the API are excluded from this policy and governed by customer agreements covering data use.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer Claude Free/Pro/Max and Claude Code on those plans use chats/coding sessions for model improvement only if you enable Model Improvement, content is safety-flagged, or you explicitly opt in (e.g. Trusted Tester). Incognito chats are never used to improve Claude even when Model Improvement is on. Commercial Claude for Work/API follow separate commercial terms.
optOutHow: Claude Settings > Data Privacy Controls: turn off Model Improvement. Use Incognito chats for sessions that should not train. Feedback (thumbs) may still be retained up to 5 years and used for training after de-linking from user ID.
retentionPeriod: Deleted conversations leave history immediately and backend storage within 30 days. If Model Improvement is enabled, de-identified data may be retained up to 5 years in training pipelines for new/resumed chats after enablement. Safety-flagged inputs/outputs up to 2 years; trust scores up to 7 years. Feedback submissions up to 5 years.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You can delete chats from the active UI. Account deletion requests are typically completed within 30 days.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with hosting providers (AWS, Google Cloud) and service providers under strict data privacy agreements. No sharing with advertisers.
humanReviewConditions: Safety reviews happen when conversations are flagged for abuse or terms of service violations. Human reviews are minimized for opted-out users.
regionalVariation: GDPR baseline applies for EU/UK users. Anthropic has designated EU and UK representatives for data protection inquiries.
childrenDataPolicy: Requires users to be at least 13 years old. Users under 18 need permission from a parent or guardian.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Console API and Claude Enterprise accounts do not train on your data by default. They offer custom retention options and HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer Gemini Apps train on future chat content, including text and attachments, unless the training setting in Gemini History is turned off. History retention is controlled separately (auto-delete 18 months by default). Human reviewers may review chats to improve Gemini and for safety; signed-out use is covered by the Google Privacy Policy.
optOutHow: In Gemini History (myactivity.google.com/product/gemini), turn off the setting that controls whether chat content, including text and attachments, is used to train generative AI models. Retention and training are separate settings, so history can be kept while training is off. Google is rolling this out globally; accounts still showing only the legacy 'Keep Activity' setting must turn that off to stop both retention and training.
retentionPeriod: Gemini History auto-deletes after 18 months by default, adjustable to 3 months, 36 months, or indefinite. Temporary chats and History-off chats are retained around two months. Reviewed chats and related data are kept up to 3 years.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Delete individual chats or clear all Keep Activity anytime. Chats already reviewed by human annotators are retained up to 3 years disconnected from your account.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with service providers for human review (disconnected from account first). Connected third-party apps receive data per their own privacy policies. Google does not sell personal data.
humanReviewConditions: A subset of chats is reviewed by human annotators to improve models, reduce unintended activations, and keep Gemini safe. Reviewers assess response quality, accuracy, and safety. Turning off Keep Activity stops future chats from being reviewed for improvement.
regionalVariation: EU/UK users have GDPR rights including right to object to processing and request data correction. Korea-based users are subject to Korean Location Terms. Some regions have different Activity defaults or require explicit consent.
childrenDataPolicy: Available to users 13+ (or regional age of consent). Teens have specific default settings. Google applies strict safety filters for teen interactions.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Work or school Google Accounts may be subject to different data handling terms under the Generative AI in Google Workspace Privacy Hub.

trainsOnDataNuance: Meta trains on public content (posts, comments, photos, audio) shared on Facebook and Instagram by default. Interactions with Meta AI features are also used for training. Information from partners, vendors, and third parties is also used.
optOutHow: No single AI-training toggle is provided. EU/UK users may object to training under applicable law, and targeted-advertising opt-outs are available through ad settings and the privacy center.
retentionPeriod: Retained on a case-by-case basis. Meta considers whether data is needed to operate products, the feature and how it works, legal obligations, and other legitimate purposes such as preventing harm or investigating violations.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Information or the account can be deleted through the provided tools; no specific deletion timeframe is stated.
thirdPartySharing: Shared across Meta platforms and with advertisers, analytics partners, integrated partners, measurement vendors, marketing vendors, service providers, external researchers, and AI integrations. Meta does not sell information to anyone.
humanReviewConditions: Manual review conducted for safety, integrity, and security purposes: verifying accounts, finding policy violations, investigating suspicious activity, detecting and preventing harmful or unlawful behavior. Some decisions are reviewed by Oversight Board.
regionalVariation: The policy links to a United States Regional Privacy Notice; EEA/UK-specific rights are not described on this page.
childrenDataPolicy: The policy does not state a minimum age; child and teen terms are not addressed on this page.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The policy does not distinguish enterprise or API terms from consumer terms.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer Microsoft Copilot may use conversation activity to train generative AI models unless you opt out. Microsoft 365 Copilot conversations are not used to train Copilot generative models. Enterprise Data Protection / commercial accounts follow separate enterprise protections.
optOutHow: In consumer Copilot privacy settings, opt out of use of conversation activity for model training. Personalization can also be disabled separately.
retentionPeriod: By default consumer Copilot conversation activity is stored for 18 months. Other retention may apply per Microsoft Privacy Statement and product settings.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You can delete individual conversations or your entire conversation history at any time through the Copilot UI or the Microsoft Privacy Dashboard.
thirdPartySharing: Conversations are not shared with other users; external research organizations may review conversation logs for safety.
humanReviewConditions: Some conversations are subject to human review for product improvement and digital safety. Conversations flagged as Code of Conduct violations may also be reviewed. Opt-out of human review is not available.
regionalVariation: EEA/UK users have access to GDPR privacy dashboards and enhanced telemetry opt-out options.
childrenDataPolicy: Requires a Microsoft account, which restricts users under 13 (or regional age limit) without explicit parental verification.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Consumer Copilot trains on conversations unless opted out; organizational Entra ID users and Microsoft 365 Copilot conversations are excluded from training.

trainsOnDataNuance: Vibe consumer users are not opted out by default and may be included in Mistral's model training programs; Vibe Enterprise is opted out by default (admin-managed opt-in), and Vibe Teams admins can disable training org-wide. Studio/API anonymous improvement data is governed by a separate Admin panel privacy toggle. Vibe opt-outs are managed in the Admin panel (admin.mistral.ai) or in the mobile app's Data & Account Controls.
optOutHow: Vibe web: Admin panel > Manage > Vibe > Privacy > disable 'Allow your interactions to be used to train our models'. Mobile: Settings > Data & Account Controls > deselect Enable data sharing. Studio/API: Admin panel > Privacy > disable Anonymous improvement data. Configure Vibe and API toggles separately.
retentionPeriod: Conversations are saved to account history indefinitely until deleted by the user. If opted out, inputs and outputs are not collected for training.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You can delete chats directly in the interface. Deletion is instantaneous in the active system. Backup copies are cleared per standard backup retention cycles.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with cloud infrastructure hosts (such as Scaleway, Azure, and AWS) in compliance with European privacy standards.
humanReviewConditions: Human review is highly restricted, limited to abuse reports, security incidents, or when legally mandated.
regionalVariation: Based in France. GDPR serves as the baseline for all users globally, providing strong default rights.
childrenDataPolicy: The consumer Le Chat service is restricted to users who are 18 years or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The developer API platform is excluded from Vibe training, and API users control anonymous improvement data separately. Enterprise contracts offer formal GDPR clauses and dedicated deployment options.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer services use data to improve or create products including AI models. Enterprise and API offerings where Perplexity acts as processor are excluded from this notice. Email Assistant content is not used to train or fine-tune AI models. Comet browser has additional browsing/history controls.
optOutHow: Export or delete data in account settings; opt out of targeted advertising via the cookie consent pop-up, app settings, or Global Privacy Control; exercise objection/access/deletion rights by contacting Perplexity.
retentionPeriod: Kept only as long as needed for the purposes in the notice unless longer retention is required or permitted by law. Thread/history retention follows account use until you delete threads or the account.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Threads and accounts can be deleted in account settings; the policy states no fixed deletion timeframe.
thirdPartySharing: Shares data with affiliates, service providers, business partners, professional services, advertising partners, and where required by law; queries may be sent to third-party LLM providers to generate answers.
humanReviewConditions: The policy does not state that humans review chats.
regionalVariation: Fully compliant with GDPR for EEA users, providing tools to export data, request deletion, and restrict processing.
childrenDataPolicy: Not meant for children under 13. Does not knowingly collect from children under 16 without parental consent.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Enterprise and API processor offerings are outside this consumer Privacy Notice and follow those product contracts.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer inputs may be used to develop and improve services and to train models. Private Chat conversations are not shown in history and are deleted from SpaceXSI systems within 30 days; the policy does not state that Private Chat is training-exempt. Business/API customers are outside this policy.
optOutHow: In the Grok mobile app: Settings > Data Controls and deselect Improve the model. On grok.com: Settings > Data > Improve the Model. Or use Private Chat (ghost icon), which is not used for training. On X, use X's Grok data settings.
retentionPeriod: Conversation history is kept while your account remains active unless you delete it. Private Chat and deleted conversations are removed from SpaceXSI systems within 30 days unless legal, compliance, or safety requires longer retention.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Delete individual or all conversations, or delete the account, from Grok settings. Deletion from SpaceXSI systems completes within 30 days unless legal/safety retention applies. Privacy requests also via https://x.ai/privacy-portal/.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with contracted service providers (hosting, cloud, analytics, safety monitoring, payments), related companies, and third parties you choose to share with (for example public share links or X). Grok on X is under X Corp terms, not this policy.
humanReviewConditions: Authorized personnel may review conversations to improve model performance, investigate security incidents and misuse, and meet legal obligations, in addition to automated safety classifiers.
regionalVariation: Europe-specific terms are in the SpaceXSI Europe Privacy Policy Addendum. EU/UK/Swiss users have additional rights and representatives listed on the privacy policy.
childrenDataPolicy: Not directed to children under 13. Ages 13–17 need parent/guardian permission. Grok can produce mature content depending on mode and prompts; parents should monitor use.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: This consumer privacy policy does not cover SpaceXSI API/business offerings, which have separate enterprise terms and exclude customer content from model improvement. Grok on X is covered by X's policies.

trainsOnDataNuance: Consumer chats are used to train and improve DeepSeek's technology, and users have a right to opt out of using their personal data for training. The policy does not state that API platform usage is excluded from training.
optOutHow: Submit a request to exercise the right to opt out of training by emailing privacy@deepseek.com.
retentionPeriod: Retained as long as necessary to provide the Services, comply with legal obligations, or for legitimate business interests; deleted or anonymized when no longer required.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You can delete chats from your history or request full account deletion. Deletion requests are processed per local regulations (such as CAC in China and GDPR in Europe).
thirdPartySharing: Shared with affiliates, infrastructure providers, and authorities under Chinese cybersecurity laws and international compliance rules.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of chats is described; the policy covers monitoring, analytics, and sharing with service providers for model training and optimization.
regionalVariation: EEA/UK/Swiss users get a supplemental GDPR clause and EU representation; personal data is collected, processed, and stored in the People's Republic of China.
childrenDataPolicy: The Services are not aimed at children, and DeepSeek does not knowingly process children's Personal Data; data found to be collected from children is handled per applicable law.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Processing by downstream applications built on the open platform is outside this policy and governed by the developer's own privacy notice.

trainsOnDataNuance: AWS Bedrock does not use customer data (inputs, outputs, or custom model weights) to train or improve any base models by default. Other AWS AI services may collect data by default but allow account-level opt-out.
optOutHow: Opt-out is the default for Bedrock (no action needed). For other AWS AI services, opt out via AWS Organizations by attaching an AI services opt-out policy.
retentionPeriod: Not stated on the Bedrock page; Bedrock never shares inputs/outputs with model providers or uses them to train foundation models, and data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: You have full ownership and control over your data. It can be deleted instantly through standard AWS console or API commands.
thirdPartySharing: Inputs and outputs are never shared with model providers or used to train foundation models; the page makes no broader statement about other third parties.
humanReviewConditions: There is no human review of prompts or responses processed through Amazon Bedrock.
regionalVariation: Bedrock adheres to GDPR, HIPAA, SOC, and FedRAMP High; the page does not describe region-specific processing differences.
childrenDataPolicy: Not stated on the Bedrock page; AWS services are provided to business/enterprise customers and account data is governed by the AWS Privacy Notice.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Bedrock is an enterprise developer service with comprehensive B2B compliance (HIPAA, SOC, GDPR), customer-managed encryption keys (KMS), and VPC connectivity.

trainsOnDataNuance: OpenRouter itself does not use Inputs or Outputs for model training. Inputs are sent to the selected model provider; some providers may retain or train on Inputs/Outputs. OpenRouter labels models that do not train where disclosed. Enterprise DPA customers get provider restrictions via contract.
optOutHow: Select model providers labeled as not using your data for training. Avoid training-permitted providers if you do not want provider-side training. Enterprise customers should use a DPA and provider routing controls.
retentionPeriod: Routing/billing/security logs as needed for operations and legal compliance. Ephemeral image/audio/video Inputs are not persisted beyond routing except for abuse, security, billing, or legal needs. Files API uploads are kept until you delete them or close your account.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Email privacy@openrouter.ai to delete account/data (confirmation required). Uploaded Files are removed from active systems/backups on delete/account close except legal/security holds.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with selected model providers for inference (and possibly their training if their terms allow), service providers, affiliates, and as required by law. OpenRouter does not sell personal data for money.
humanReviewConditions: Personnel do not access Uploaded File contents except to investigate Terms violations, respond to legal process, or provide support; the policy does not describe a chat-review program.
regionalVariation: Follows GDPR for EU users. Data handling depends on the underlying model provider's policies.
childrenDataPolicy: Site and service are for users 18 years of age or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Users with a Data Processing Agreement have provider handling and training restrictions governed by that DPA and OpenRouter's provider contracts, not only the public privacy policy.

trainsOnDataNuance: Workers AI does not use Customer Content to train AI models and does not retain inputs/outputs for standard inference. AI Gateway forwards content to the AI provider you choose, which processes it under its own terms. Stateful features you select (R2/KV/Vectorize, logging/caching, async/batch) store content under that feature's lifecycle.
optOutHow: Not applicable for Workers AI, which does not train on Customer Content. AI Gateway content sent to third-party providers is governed by that provider's terms.
retentionPeriod: Zero data retention for standard inference: inputs/outputs are not retained after the request. Content is stored only when you use a stateful feature (storage services, AI Gateway logging/caching, async or batch features) as governed by that feature, plus operational metadata without Customer Content.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Submit a Rights Request to sar@cloudflare.com; Cloudflare responds within 30 days.
thirdPartySharing: AI Gateway sends Customer Content to the AI provider you select, which processes it under its own terms; Cloudflare does not make Customer Content available to other Cloudflare customers.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of AI Gateway traffic.
regionalVariation: EU/UK/Swiss GDPR rights and Data Privacy Framework participation; California CCPA rights; data stored primarily in the United States and the EEA.
childrenDataPolicy: Enterprise platform restricted to users 18 years or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Workers AI is governed by the Self-Serve Subscription Agreement or, for enterprise customers, the Enterprise Subscription Agreement, in addition to the Cloudflare Privacy Policy.

trainsOnDataNuance: Groq does not train on customer data. The cited Customer Data Processing Addendum states no prompt or response retention period; retention is governed by the consumer Privacy Policy and the addendum's deletion terms.
optOutHow: Not applicable - no training occurs.
retentionPeriod: The consumer Privacy Policy retains information for the period necessary to fulfill the policy's purposes unless a longer period is required by law; the DPA requires deletion of Personal Data within a maximum of 180 days after termination on request. No 7-day abuse-retention period is stated.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Deletion requests are answered within the time required by applicable law; the DPA requires prompt deletion within a maximum of 180 days after termination on request.
thirdPartySharing: Disclosed to affiliates, service providers, your organization, legal authorities, and in business transactions; targeted-advertising partners under US state laws.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of customer prompts or responses.
regionalVariation: GDPR compliant for EU users.
childrenDataPolicy: Restricted to users 18 years or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Business Cloud Services and Customer Data are governed by the Groq Services Agreement and Data Processing Addendum, not this consumer Policy.

trainsOnDataNuance: Cerebras does not retain inputs and outputs associated with its training, inference, and chatbot services; the policy does not state whether non-retained inputs are used to train models.
optOutHow: Not applicable; the policy states inputs and outputs are not retained and describes no training on them.
retentionPeriod: Personal data is retained for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes in the policy; inputs and outputs of training, inference, and chatbot services are not retained.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: No timeframe stated; deletion requests are handled per applicable law.
thirdPartySharing: Disclosed to affiliates or subsidiaries, vendors, resellers, business transferees, and legal recipients; Cerebras does not sell or share personal information under the CCPA.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of customer data.
regionalVariation: EEA/UK residents have GDPR rights and California residents have CCPA rights; data may be transferred to and processed in the United States.
childrenDataPolicy: Does not knowingly collect Personal Data from minors under 13.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The policy excludes data processed as a processor/service provider and employee data; separate agreements govern those.

trainsOnDataNuance: Fireworks AI does not use customer data to train models without explicit opt-in. Zero Data Retention is available for open models by default.
optOutHow: Not applicable - training requires explicit opt-in.
retentionPeriod: Zero data retention for open models absent explicit opt-in; otherwise retained as long as reasonably necessary for the stated purposes.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Data deletion available via API or support request.
thirdPartySharing: No customer data is shared for training purposes.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of customer prompts or outputs.
regionalVariation: US-based company with GDPR compliance for EU users.
childrenDataPolicy: Not directed to children under 13; the policy states it does not intend to or knowingly collect personal data from children.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: When acting as a service provider for businesses, this Privacy Notice does not apply; those arrangements are governed by the customer's terms.

trainsOnDataNuance: Together AI does not train on collected data without explicit opt-in and consent; Zero Data Retention applies when you choose "No" to storing prompts/permitting training in Privacy & Security settings. Consent can be revoked at any time.
optOutHow: In Privacy & Security settings choose "No" to storing prompts and to allowing data to train models; deletion and rights requests can go to privacy@together.ai.
retentionPeriod: Retained only as long as necessary; content is not stored, retained, or used for training when Zero Data Retention is enabled; some usage data is kept for shorter periods per product.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Delete in product settings or email privacy@together.ai; CCPA requests are answered within 45 days.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with service providers, third-party vendors, consultants, and partners, and in business transfers; not sold under CCPA.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of chats is mentioned in the policy.
regionalVariation: US-based company with GDPR compliance for EU users.
childrenDataPolicy: Services are not directed to, or intended for, anyone under 13; parental consent applies where local law requires.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Enterprise accounts offer custom data retention and compliance options.

trainsOnDataNuance: NIM-specific training terms are not published on the cited pages, so this record follows the NVIDIA Privacy Policy, which states no training on customer AI data; inference-data terms are otherwise not stated.
optOutHow: Not applicable - no training on customer AI data.
retentionPeriod: Not stated on the cited pages; the general NVIDIA Privacy Policy governs retention.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Data deletion available via NVIDIA account privacy settings.
thirdPartySharing: Not stated on the cited pages; the general NVIDIA Privacy Policy governs sharing.
humanReviewConditions: Not stated on the cited pages; no human-review commitment for inference data is published.
regionalVariation: Region-specific NVIDIA privacy pages exist; the cited pages state no GDPR or data-residency commitments.
childrenDataPolicy: Not stated on the cited pages; the general NVIDIA Privacy Policy governs children's data.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The cited pages do not distinguish enterprise from consumer terms.

trainsOnDataNuance: Sarvam uses user content (inputs, uploads, prompts, and generated outputs) to train, fine-tune, and improve its AI models unless the user explicitly opts out through account settings or by writing to privacy@sarvam.ai. Enterprise/business content processed under separate agreements is excluded.
optOutHow: Opt out of training in account settings or by writing to privacy@sarvam.ai; consent can be withdrawn at any time with prospective effect.
retentionPeriod: Your content (inputs/outputs) is user-configurable with a default of 30 days after last access; account data is kept for the account duration plus 90 days post-termination unless early deletion is requested; usage/technical logs 1 year; voice-cloning consent audit logs 3 years post-deletion.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Data is deleted within 30 days of request verification; backups are deleted or anonymized where immediate deletion is impracticable.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with vendors, payment gateways, and analytics providers; de-identified data may be shared with partners; Sarvam states it does not sell personal data.
humanReviewConditions: The policy does not state whether personnel review chats.
regionalVariation: India-based company with standard privacy protections.
childrenDataPolicy: Services are not directed to under-18s and under-18 accounts require verifiable parental consent; voice cloning is prohibited for under-18s.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Enterprise/business offering content is governed by customer agreements, not the public consumer Privacy Policy.

trainsOnDataNuance: Z.ai uses account, usage, log, and publicly available internet data to develop, improve, and promote its Services, including to train and improve its models. User content is processed in real time to provide the Service.
optOutHow: Object to processing, withdraw consent, or limit collection and use by contacting user_feedback@z.ai; chats can be deleted in settings. No training-specific opt-out is described.
retentionPeriod: Account information and inputs are retained as long as you have an account; retention otherwise depends on the purpose, legal requirements, and the policy's criteria.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Data deletion available upon request.
thirdPartySharing: Disclosed to affiliates in the Z.ai Group, vendors and analytics providers, business transferees, and government authorities where required; the policy does not state that personal data is sold.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of chats is stated; the policy states it does not engage in decision-making based solely on automated processing.
regionalVariation: Standard privacy protections apply.
childrenDataPolicy: Not intended for users under 18; under-18 use requires parent or guardian permission, and data from under-13s is not knowingly collected.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The consumer policy applies to individual users and excludes content processed on behalf of business customers; API/enterprise content is governed by the customer agreement (customer is controller).

trainsOnDataNuance: This policy excludes data submitted to Kong-hosted services (including AI Gateway); training practices for gateway data are not stated here and are governed by the Kong Konnect Customer Agreement or software license.
optOutHow: Policy opt-outs cover marketing communications and cookies; no AI-training opt-out is stated.
retentionPeriod: Stored as long as necessary for the purposes collected and to comply with legal retention requirements; no AI-specific period is stated.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Submit requests to privacyrequests@konghq.com or via the privacy request form; archived/backup copies may be retained as required or allowed by law.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with vendors and service providers, affiliates, prospective purchasers, advertising/analytics partners, and for legal requests; Kong does not sell personal information of California residents.
humanReviewConditions: Not addressed; this policy excludes Kong-hosted cloud services, telemetry, and platform support data.
regionalVariation: Separate California (CCPA) disclosures and EEA/UK (GDPR) sections apply, including legal bases, rights, and international-transfer safeguards.
childrenDataPolicy: Sites and Services are not meant for children under 13; no knowing collection under 13 without parental consent.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Website/Sites and Services follow this policy; Kong-hosted cloud, telemetry, and support data follow the Kong Konnect Customer Agreement or software license.

trainsOnDataNuance: Portkey acts as an AI gateway and forwards requests to the selected model provider; the published policy does not address training on customer data.
optOutHow: No training opt-out is described; the policy does not address training on customer data.
retentionPeriod: Minimal logging for operations. No AI-specific data retention.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Data deletion available via API.
thirdPartySharing: Data is forwarded to the configured upstream AI provider.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of gateway traffic.
regionalVariation: Standard privacy protections apply.
childrenDataPolicy: Restricted to users 18 years or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Same privacy terms for all users.

trainsOnDataNuance: Self-hosted LiteLLM stores no data or telemetry on LiteLLM servers; requests are routed to the model providers you configure. The page makes no training statement.
optOutHow: Not applicable; self-hosted deployments keep all data in the customer's infrastructure.
retentionPeriod: No data retention by default. Self-hosted solution.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: N/A - self-hosted, user controls all data.
thirdPartySharing: No data sharing - requests forwarded to configured model providers.
humanReviewConditions: Not addressed in the Data Privacy and Security page.
regionalVariation: Not addressed; self-hosted deployments are operated by the customer.
childrenDataPolicy: Not addressed; developer/self-hosted software.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Same privacy terms for all users - self-hosted open-source software.

trainsOnDataNuance: Open-source framework; no formal privacy policy is published, so training practices are not stated.
optOutHow: No formal privacy policy is published. Telemetry opt-out is documented in the Haystack docs.
retentionPeriod: No data retention - self-hosted open-source framework.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: N/A - self-hosted, user controls all data.
thirdPartySharing: No formal privacy policy is published. Haystack collects anonymous usage telemetry, and integrations forward data to third-party model providers the user configures.
humanReviewConditions: No human review - open-source framework.
regionalVariation: N/A - self-hosted solution.
childrenDataPolicy: N/A - developer tool.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Same privacy terms for all users - self-hosted open-source software.

trainsOnDataNuance: Enterprise accounts do not train on customer data by default. Trial and Research accounts may use de-identified data for R&D. Cohere does not intentionally collect personal information for training.
optOutHow: Not applicable for enterprise - no training by default. Trial users can upgrade to enterprise for full data protection.
retentionPeriod: Enterprise: 30 days for inputs/outputs. Trial/Research: Data used for R&D (de-identified).
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Account deletion and data removal available. Enterprise accounts have formal DPA options.
thirdPartySharing: Disclosed to affiliates, vendors and service providers, legal authorities, and in business transactions; sub-processors are listed at trustcenter.cohere.com/subprocessors.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of enterprise customer data.
regionalVariation: Canadian company; EEA/UK/Swiss users are covered by an additional European-residents section with GDPR rights and international-transfer safeguards.
childrenDataPolicy: Not intended for use by minors. Restricted to users 18 years or older.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: Enterprise accounts have formal data protection agreements, no training, and 30-day retention.

trainsOnDataNuance: The policy does not address model training or Inference API training; it states Hugging Face will not sell, rent, or lease personal information.
optOutHow: No training opt-out is described; the policy does not address training on customer data.
retentionPeriod: Data retained as long as necessary to deliver services and comply with legal requirements.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Account deletion and data removal available via privacy@huggingface.co.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with service providers (AWS, GCP, etc.) under strict data privacy agreements.
humanReviewConditions: No human review of customer inference data.
regionalVariation: French company with EU presence. GDPR compliant. CNIL registered.
childrenDataPolicy: Services are not directed to children under 13; personal information from anyone known to be under 13 is not knowingly collected.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: The Policy applies to all users; organization agreements may also govern processing, but no separate enterprise privacy terms are described.

trainsOnDataNuance: Replicate does not sell or share personal information; customers may upload Training Data to train their own models on the platform. The policy does not state that Replicate trains on customer data.
optOutHow: Marketing emails can be unsubscribed via the instructions in the email; analytics cookies can be rejected through browser settings.
retentionPeriod: Retained as long as necessary to provide services. Abuse detection and legal compliance.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Account deletion and data removal available via privacy@replicate.com.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with service providers for operations. Not sold to advertisers.
humanReviewConditions: The policy does not describe human review of customer inputs or outputs.
regionalVariation: US-based company (San Francisco). Standard privacy protections.

trainsOnDataNuance: Cursor does not use Inputs or Suggestions to train models by default, and does not let third parties train on them, unless content is flagged for security review, you submit Feedback, or you explicitly agree to training. Privacy Mode (when enabled) also enforces zero data retention with model providers. Turning Privacy Mode off allows Cursor to store and train on codebase/prompt data.
optOutHow: Keep Privacy Mode enabled in Cursor settings (and online account settings) so training stays off and ZDR applies. Only disable Privacy Mode if you accept training and non-ZDR retention.
retentionPeriod: Retained as needed to operate the service, legal compliance, safety, and dispute resolution. Privacy Mode uses ZDR with providers; temporary encrypted file cache exists for latency and is not used as training data when Privacy Mode is on. Some temporary interactions may be stored briefly for safety/monitoring.
dataDeletedOnRequestTimeframe: Request access/deletion via hi@cursor.com or account controls. Data is deleted, erased, de-identified, or anonymized when no longer needed.
thirdPartySharing: Shared with vendors (hosting, cloud, model providers, analytics, support, safety, payments). Subprocessors for commercial processor use are listed at trust.cursor.com/subprocessors. Model providers under Privacy Mode operate under ZDR agreements except designated non-ZDR models.
humanReviewConditions: Staff do not read Google-connected Grok Bot data unless you ask for support, for security investigations, or to comply with law. Security-flagged Inputs/Suggestions may be analyzed to improve abuse detection.
regionalVariation: GDPR protections apply for EU and UK users, including data deletion and processing objection.
childrenDataPolicy: Does not knowingly collect information from children under 18. Accounts suspected to be under 18 may be investigated and deleted.
enterpriseVsConsumerSummary: When Anysphere acts as a processor for commercial/enterprise customers, processing is governed by customer agreements rather than this consumer privacy policy. Business account admins can access and manage member use.
